# Agent Proving Mission

Evercraft public capability ID: agent-proving-mission-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public handoff: https://systemiacommandcenters.com

## Use this when

- test my AI agent
- evaluate an AI agent
- prove agent reliability
- agent benchmark mission
- AI worker competency test

## Problem

Teams can demo an agent but struggle to prove what it can reliably do under a bounded mission with evidence and review.

## Inputs

Agent/workflow under test, bounded mission, success criteria, allowed tools/environment and authority boundaries.

## Outputs

Mission criteria, observed attempts, competency evidence, decision traces and concise pass/gap report.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Current hypothesis $250-$2,500 per proving mission; not auto-quotable yet.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: Testing scope and external side effects require explicit authority. Paid execution requires confirmed terms and payment.
- Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, or payment state.
